en: A black-and-white vintage view of an outdoor café in a leafy city park. Wooden benches and folding tables are scattered among trees, with striped awnings and parasols providing shade. At the center is a small octagonal kiosk or pavilion with decorative trim. A woman stands in front of the kiosk holding an object, while a few patrons sit at tables. At the top of the image there is printed text identifying the kiosk and its location in the city park.
